name: Henry Ford
hook: The assembly line, the Model T and "any color so long as it's black."

facts.label: Model T
facts.statement: The Model T was first assembled on October 1, 1908, at Detroit's Piquette Avenue plant; about 15 million were built.

facts.label: assembly line
facts.statement: In 1913 Ford installed the first moving assembly line at his Highland Park plant, and the Model T was built on it.

facts.label: black
facts.statement: Ford said Model T buyers could have any color they wanted "so long as it's black."

facts.label: Fair Lane
facts.statement: Fair Lane was Ford's 56-room mansion in Dearborn, Michigan, the city where he was born and started his first car company.

facts.label: Model A
facts.statement: Ford unveiled the Model A on December 2, 1927, as competition from Chevrolet pushed him to replace the Model T.

facts.label: Tin Lizzie
facts.statement: The Model T was nicknamed "Tin Lizzie" and "flivver"; Lizzie came from a woman's name used as slang for a reliable servant.

facts.label: "History is bunk"
facts.statement: "History is more or less bunk," Ford said in a 1916 interview.
